refnamediv.refpurpose: sets the filename for the JXAC anticheat log

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: jxac_logFile sets the filename for the JXAC anticheat log. Relative filenames are resolved beneath fs_homepath/fs_game; the default is fs_homepath/fs_game/jxac/jxac.log. Parent directories are created automatically. Explicit absolute custom filenames remain supported. Existing files are appended to; an empty filename disables this log.
